questionText: What structural relationships are forming around NVIDIA across ownership, technology, and capital?

probe.subject: NVIDIA
probe.analysisSentence: 52 admitted relationships (6 beneficial-ownership disclosures, 1 capital-event relationship, 20 officer or director disclosures, 20 granted-patent assignments, 5 named-in-article relationships) connect 2 domains: CAPITAL ↔ OWNERSHIP (pair name: financing of control / control financed · one admitted relationship speaks to both); KNOWLEDGE (patent-derived) counts toward coverage and forms no link; MEDIA (named-in-article) counts toward coverage and forms no link.
